Chapter 6115: Transcendent

Chapter 6115: Transcendent

Two half-step and three apex emperors shook the world. A battle between them could destroy the major ghost market.

“Enigma is still unified.” A spectator said after seeing Dragonform’s involvement.

Normally, Dragonform was not close to the emperors nor participated in the administration of the dynasty. Now, he still joined them in times of need.

“I must have this grass.” Yangrune’s imperial aura could break through the world like gales against dried branches.

“The same for us.” Disaster answered before Endlaw could, not yielding an inch.

Disaster always followed his heart - loving his friends and despising his enemies. He kept up this honesty even after becoming an emperor, not putting on a facade for reputation’s sake.

He didn’t change his personality and didn’t care for others’ opinions. This youthful and hot-headed style won him some fans.

“Back to where we started then.” Bloodsparrow said. The cold aura from her eyes pricked the spectators’ chest, starkly contrasting her fiery external aura.

“It’s coming.” Spectators immediately retreated to a safe distance.

“To the death. We are not afraid of your dynasty.” Disaster said.

Listeners who were enemies of Immortal Suppression enjoyed his stance. Although they didn’t dare to say something like this, they vented through him.

“You should be, since we can destroy Enigma.” A chilling voice caused many to roll on the ground in pain; their eardrums ruptured.

“Clank!” A pair of golden wings spread in the air, stopping time itself in the market. An unknown power took over and froze people in place.

All eyes were on the beautiful wings. Each feather was an immaculate work of art. Spectators felt they were looking at a golden crown; few were worthy of wearing it.

The owner of the wings landed inside Darkmoon Temple, outshining everything else including the apex emperors.

Putting his aura aside, his physical appearance exceeded the limit of the mortal world. The fairest ladies and most handsome gentlemen paled in comparison.

The gleams from his hair illuminated everyone’s heart, making them think of him as a supreme being from above. His green eyes captivated the soul; no female audience members were spared.

“So this is love at first sight.” Someone commented.

“Handsome indeed.” The men stated with admiration. They were jealous of better-looking men but being jealous of him seemed sacrilegious.

“Transcendent Emperor.” Another stated his title - one known to all of Sin.

I would be more than happy to kneel and kiss his foot -

princesses and saintesses shared this outrageous sentiment.

His appearance alone shook them to the core, let alone his fame and reputation.

“So he is Transcendent Emperor.” Those who hated Immortal Suppression lowered their head, unable to stare at him directly.

He was the second-ranked emperor in Immortal Suppression only behind Tranquility Emperor. However, he was the youngest.
